### Bible Pathway - February 3
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-3-2013.html
Passage: Leviticus 7:2
Points:
- The trespass (guilt) offering addressed specific sins against God and neighbor, requiring full restitution plus an additional penalty.
- Committing a trespass in ignorance still incurred guilt, showing that neglect of God's Word does not excuse disobedience.
- Worshipers could not eat from the trespass offering, coming solely as unworthy sinners seeking reconciliation.
- The consecration of the priests with sacrificial blood symbolized dedicating one's hearing, actions, and walk entirely to the Lord.
- Believers are called to conduct their daily lives honorably, having been sanctified and cleansed through Jesus Christ, our High Priest.
